svg.title: From installation to your first task
svg.desc: Start with the copyable request in this guide. Ask your assistant to install: Paste the repository link and install request. The assistant checks the route for your app. Follow the steps for your app: Claude: add the marketplace and plugin. Codex: copy the complete kit into your project. Check in a new task or chat: All seven skills should be available. Use de-business-kit. Show me one small task. Installation walkthrough, not an app screenshot.

g.text: From installation to your first task
Start with the copyable request in this guide.
Paste the repository link and install request.
The assistant checks the route for your app.
Follow the steps for your app
Claude: add the marketplace and plugin.
Codex: copy the complete kit into your project.
Check in a new task or chat
All seven skills should be available.
Use de-business-kit. Show me one small task.
Installation walkthrough, not an app screenshot.
